Selected whole-home interior remodel, not reconstruction

Selected interior remodel of an existing 1800 SF one-story home in Boise, Idaho, not a gut renovation and not new construction. Replace 1600 SF flooring with contractor-supplied LVP and 80 SF bathroom floor tile; retain 120 SF utility-room flooring untouched. Paint 4000 SF wall surface and 1800 SF ceilings. Replace 12 interior doors and 550 LF baseboard. Kitchen: supply/install 18 LF base cabinets, 12 LF wall cabinets, 45 SF quartz, one sink and one faucet. Two bathrooms: each supply/install one 30-inch vanity with integrated top/sink, one faucet and one toilet; existing tub/showers stay untouched. Existing plumbing locations remain. Include removal/disposal of replaced finishes, minor prep, reconnects, normal materials and cleanup. Mid-range finishes, unoccupied, normal access and schedule. Exclude roof, windows, exterior, structural work, full rewiring, HVAC, shower remodeling, appliances, permit fees and design.
